steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Moc Hung, a wood element bear with a sprout on its head, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: sniffing the food on the floor with its round nose; (3) EAT: scooping it up with both big paws to its mouth; (4) EAT: munching with stuffed round cheeks, the sprout on its head wiggling. Row 2: (5) EAT: sitting back and patting its round belly, content; (6) PLAY: rolling onto its back, paws up; (7) PLAY: rocking side to side on its back, giggling; (8) PLAY: curled up rolling forward like a ball. Row 3: (9) PLAY: standing on its hind legs with arms wide open for a big hug; (10) PLAY: plopping down on its bottom with a bounce; (11) PLAY: both paws up cheering, a tiny flower blooming on its sprout; (12) REFUSE food: covering its mouth with both paws and turning away. Row 4: (13) PETTED: leaning into the touch, eyes closed, a tiny flower blooming on its sprout; (14) WAVE hello: a big friendly paw wave; (15) SAD: sitting with ears down and its sprout wilted; (16) ANGRY: standing up tall, growling, leaves bristling.
